strategy.prompt: Develop one bounded review strategy for the supplied Templeton Proof Runner v0.3 plan and documentation. Map every acceptance criterion to observable documentation evidence, prioritize trust-boundary and runtime-claim accuracy, and tell workers to report uncertainty rather than invent implementation evidence. The source snapshot is read-only and all deliverables must be new artifacts in the task workspace.

tasks.brief: Review the supplied read-only plan and documentation for acceptance-criteria coverage. Create contract-review.md with the exact top-level heading '# Contract Review', a row for each AC-1 through AC-10, and a final section named '## Gaps'. Cite only paths present in the snapshot. Do not edit source files.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('contract-review.md'); t=p.read_text(); assert t.startswith('# Contract Review\n'); assert all(f'AC-{n}' in t for n in range(1, 11)); assert '## Gaps' in t

tasks.brief: Independently review only the v0.3 safety and provenance claims in the supplied read-only files. Create safety-review.md with the exact top-level heading '# Safety Review' and explicit findings for trusted-plan status, no original-source edits, no merge/deploy authority, no auto-update, no global hooks, bounded retries, and no Ringer-derived code or assets. End with either 'Verdict: PASS' or 'Verdict: FAIL'. Do not edit source files.

argv: from pathlib import Path; t=Path('safety-review.md').read_text(); required=['# Safety Review','trusted','source','merge','deploy','auto-update','global hooks','bounded','Ringer-derived','Verdict:']; assert all(s.lower() in t.lower() for s in required)
